correctness.rationale: All edge matrices are symmetric doubly stochastic with eigenvalues 1,1,r and positive entries on active pairs. Exact multiplication yields nonstationary trace \(\tau=-(1+r)(r^2-10r+1)/8\) and product determinant \(r^3\); the discriminant factors as \((1-r)^4(r^2-14r+1)/64\). For \(r>r_*\), conjugate modulus is \(r^{3/2}\), increasing in \(r\); for \(r<r_*\), both roots are negative and the displayed spectral-radius numerator consists of two positive strictly decreasing functions of \(r\), proving unique global minimization at \(r_*\). At the double root, nonsymmetry contradicts diagonalizability of a doubly stochastic matrix with scalar action on the zero-sum eigenspace. The exact-rational verifier replayed 24 cases; the proof establishes the all-parameter signs independently.

value.rationale: The natural smallest nontrivial closed cyclic edge-diffusion sweep is a canonical numerical splitting and averaging operation. Its exact sharp finite-duration optimal tuning, defective spectral transition, and limiting 6.50-fold loss under full local equilibration answer a motivated algorithm-design question and distinguish per-sweep spectral performance from local positivity and detailed balance. No arbitrary parameter slice or merely routine substitution is required.
